d: Night. Countryside with mountain in perspective; Atlas above the top of the mountain, which supports the sky above its shoulders. Many Genes are sitting at the foot of the mountain. Zoroaster, leaning on a rock, is contemplating the motions of the stars.
Grove with shepherds huts. Dorida, then Orlando.
View of the sea in afar; on one side grove of lauri, and on the other a mouth of cave. Angelica, Medoro and Zoroastro.
Angelica running away, and then Orlando.
Palm fence, Medoro and then Dorinda.
Orlando, sleeping, Zoroaster and then Dorinda.
Angelica, Orlando, Medoro, Zoroastro and Dorinda.
